subject: Urgent: candidate called to active duty — propose recorded coding exercise & panel reassignment
messages:

From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@gmail.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 05:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: On-site interview confirmation — Tue 3/23 10:00–1:00 PT

Hi Priyom —

I hate to do this last minute but I just received notification that I was called up for active duty with a same-day requirement to report. I am leaving tonight and won't be available for the in-person loop next Tuesday. I can provide documentation (attached) and would like to request an alternative: either a remote/recorded coding exercise I can complete over the next few days, or reschedule the on-site to when I'm back (unknown at this point).

Happy to share more details; sorry again for the sudden change.

—Jordan
Jordan Miles
+1 (617) 555-0199

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: On-site interview confirmation — candidate called to active duty — proposed plan

Laura / Marcus —

Jordan just sent this — called up to active duty and leaving on short notice (attached verification). Jordan is keen to keep the process moving if we can accommodate. Two options I propose:

1) Offer a recorded coding exercise + 48–72 hour turnaround. We can provide a short (60–90 minute expected) coding prompt, candidate records their screen or submits code + writeup, and we do an asynchronous debrief.

2) Pause and reschedule the on-site once they return — timeline unknown.

Given hiring urgency for Backend IC-2 role, my recommendation is option 1 to avoid losing the candidate. If you agree, I can:
- Share the coding instructions (I have a standard exercise)
- Request a recorded session or code repo link from Jordan
- Move Marcus and Laura to asynchronous debriefs after submission (we'll share a short rubric)

Laura — if you're okay, can you confirm rubric expectations and whether Marcus can do the backend rubric as an async review?

Thanks,
Priyom
Technical Recruiter
[Attachment: military_orders.jpg forwarded]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:35:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: On-site interview confirmation — candidate called to active duty — proposed plan

Thanks for flagging — Priyom, I agree with option 1. We have a hard hiring need and this candidate has been strong in interviews so far. For the rubric:

- Backend prompt: correctness (50%), code clarity & tests (20%), system tradeoffs & writeup (20%), runtime/optimizations (10%)
- Expected turnaround: 48 hours after candidate acknowledges
- Recording optional — repo + README + short design doc acceptable

Marcus, are you able to complete the async review within 48 hours of submission? If so I'll mark this as "asynchronous loop" and proceed.

Priyom — please send the exercise and the Drive link; include a point of contact for any access questions. Also please add a short note about accommodations for military service and that we are flexible on deadlines if needed.

Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, Backend | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 17:12:00 -0000
Subject: Next steps — recorded coding exercise & instructions (flexible deadline)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the heads-up and for sharing your documentation. First and foremost, thank you for your service — we appreciate the notification and want to be flexible. Per our conversation with the hiring team, here's a proposal so we can keep the process moving while you are away:

What we offer:
- A recorded/remote coding exercise (attached instructions) — expected effort ~90 minutes to 2 hours.
- Turnaround: standard is 48 hours, but we will be flexible if your deployment schedule requires it. Please let me know a comfortable window.
- Submission: public/private GitHub repo link + README; recording optional.
- Evaluation: Laura and Marcus will do an async review against the rubric.

Links & attachments:
- Exercise doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-coding-exercises [View]
- Instructions attached: recorded_coding_instructions.pdf (see attachment)
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-9876

If that works, reply with what turnaround you expect (48 hours is fine if you're available, otherwise tell us a date and we'll honor it). No need to rush — we're happy to accommodate deployment constraints.

Best wishes, stay safe, and please reach out if there's anything we can do on logistics.

—Priyom
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
